race.description: Atr Pest Solutions Pty Ltd Mdn Plate (C1)
race.comment: CALL ME RHONDA (5) progressed nicely last time out to finish just a length from the winner in second over 2200m at Donald. Not much tougher this time so can go one better but will need a smart steer from out there. WIZARD'S STAR (10) has put together back-to-back placings, the latest when third over 2000m at Hawkesbury. Drops back to the mile and gets a good chance to finally get off the mark. MANZOBEEL (7) is ticking along nicely and gets the 4kg claimer on to get her in light. Worth including. BULLA VINAKA (1) is knocking on the door and strips rock-hard fit. Mile should suit and he gets his chance to break a long run of outs.
